label: AI, data, and compute infrastructure estate
domain: algorithmic systems, cloud services, models, chips, data centers, data brokers, government deployments, and compute procurement
scope: Government and regulated uses of algorithmic tools, AI and data suppliers, cloud-authorized services, foundation and application models, data brokers, chips, compute clusters, data centers, deployment contracts, assurance records, and public transparency inventories. The estate distinguishes vendor, product, authorization, deployment, data source, model, compute, and decision use.

asset_refs.role: bounded frontier survey and acquisition preparation

boundary: A cloud authorization, model capability, vendor contract, algorithmic record, and deployed decision system are separate states. Shared infrastructure does not establish data sharing or common purpose.

next_acquisition.operation: freeze public AI-system and cloud-service denominators and join system, vendor, model, data, compute, contract, deployment, and assurance records
next_acquisition.decisive_output: system-level ledger of owner, vendor, model, data, compute, authorization, contract, deployment phase, users, impacts, and retirement or nondeployment controls
